issues.concern: The English translation 'I was instilled with fear' is unnatural and grammatically awkward. 'Instill' is typically used with an abstract noun as the direct object, and the recipient of the instilling is the indirect object (e.g., 'instill fear in someone').
issues.suggestion: A more natural translation would be 'Fear was instilled in me' or 'I was made to feel fear' or 'Fear was planted in me'.
